summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, announcing pricing terms for cash tender offers for four series of senior unsecured notes due 2028, launched August 5, 2026. The offers are subject to a maximum aggregate purchase price of $6.75 billion (increased from $5.0 billion), with sub-caps for May 2028 ($1.0 billion) and March 2028 ($1.75 billion) notes. Consideration per $1,000 ranges from $975.63 to $1,032.08, based on fixed spreads over U.S. Treasury reference yields. Offers expire at 5:00 p.m. New York time on the filing date. Watch acceptance priority, proration, and market reaction to HSBC's liability management.
